# Genuine V0.3.3 fixture provenance

third-chapter and complete-content save from
`test-results/network-N08-UX14-17-genuin-76587--complete-V0-3-3-on-desktop/desktop-v033-save.json`.
All JSON values are unchanged; only the file's final newline is normalized.
It is not a newer state relabeled as schema 6.

`v0.3.3-offline-reference.json` records 86,400,517 milliseconds of advancement
and its return report using the exact `src/game` tree archived from published
commit `d2dca809df0694718079830dbd3c99e060eb2ff3`. That isolated released engine
decoded the genuine fixture, called `advance`, generated `summarize`, and
passed its original `assertInvariants`. The comparison fixture includes the

Migration tests compare every retained prior-version field, excluding only the
